fails_if: the SCB value reader reads an undelivered code, label, version, level or validity date as a delivered empty one (or the reverse), or drops the blank-code row 6 from the prepared associations
note: Row 6 delivers a blank code, which is missing data and never a member (maintainer decision 2026-10-09); binding states no member for it, but preparation keeps it as evidence: the Vardemangder association count must still equal the snapshot's. Row 5's undelivered code stays a missing code. Both are pinned at the build boundary, cases/build/value-code-lists-withhold-only-contested-or-unknown-periods (BLANK, LBLANK, NOCELLS).
